title: BC Appliance Rebates 2026: $50 to $200, Doubled in Some Areas
desc: BC Hydro pays $50 to $200 on ENERGY STAR washers, dryers, fridges and laundry centres until January 8, 2027, and twice that in some postal codes. FortisBC rates too.
lead: BC Hydro's fall appliance deals run from October 2, 2026 to January 8, 2027. In some postal codes BC Hydro pays the same amount a second time. Kelowna and Penticton homes use FortisBC's appliance rebates instead. We re-read BC Hydro's page on October 28, 2026, and the FortisBC pages on October 11, 2026.
cards_intro: BC Hydro's amounts are for ENERGY STAR models on its eligible lists, bought from a store in BC Hydro's service area. FortisBC's amounts are for FortisBC and City of Penticton electricity customers.

cards.title: BC Hydro: laundry centre
cards.note: A stacked washer and dryer unit on BC Hydro's list. Up to two of each listed model per purchase.

cards.title: BC Hydro: clothes dryer
cards.note: Only dryers on BC Hydro's eligible dryer list. Up to two of each listed model per purchase.

cards.title: BC Hydro: washer-dryer combo
cards.note: One machine that washes and dries, on BC Hydro's list of eligible combination washer-dryers. Up to two of each listed model per purchase.

cards.title: BC Hydro: fridge and washer
cards.note: The fridge must be at least 15% more efficient than the federal standard. Both must be on BC Hydro's lists.

cards.title: BC Hydro: air fryer
cards.note: Single or dual basket models priced $50 or more, at the till only, from October 2, 2026 to March 5, 2027. Combo air fryers do not count.

cards.title: Community top-up
cards.note: For homes in select postal codes. Paid only when you apply online after you buy.

cards.title: FortisBC: washer and dryer
cards.note: Washer $100. Dryers $100, $150 or $250 depending on efficiency. Apply within 60 days.

cards.title: FortisBC: fridge
cards.note: $100 for a fridge 15% better than the federal standard, $50 for 10% better. 11 cubic feet or more, two doors.

after_cards:
A worked example

You buy a listed laundry centre at a participating store and get $200 off at the till. If your postal code is in BC Hydro's community offer, you then apply online for the top-up of 100% of the regular rebate, another $200. That is $400 back on one purchase, by our arithmetic from BC Hydro's two pages.
sections:
BC Hydro takes $25 off an air fryer when you buy it. The deal runs from October 2, 2026 to March 5, 2027, which is two months longer than the appliance deals. The air fryer must be on BC Hydro's list of eligible air fryers, cost $50 or more, and be new. Open box and refurbished units do not count.

Only single basket and dual basket air fryers qualify. An air fryer that also grills, toasts, works as a toaster oven or multi-cooks is a combo, and BC Hydro says combos are not eligible. You can use the rebate on one unit per approved air fryer in each purchase.

This one works only at the till. Air fryers get no rebate after you buy, so if the store does not take the $25 off at checkout, you cannot claim it later. BC Hydro lists these stores for in-store air fryer rebates: Best Buy, Canadian Tire, Costco, London Drugs, RONA, The Brick and Visions Electronics. Online, it lists Best Buy, The Brick and Visions Electronics.
Money off at the till, or a bill credit later

At a participating store, the rebate comes off when you pay. BC Hydro lists Best Buy, Canadian Appliance Source, Midland Appliances, RONA, The Brick, The Home Depot, Trail Appliances and Visions Electronics for in-store appliance rebates. Online, it lists Best Buy, Canadian Appliance Source, Midland Appliances, The Brick and Visions Electronics.

Bought somewhere else? You can still apply online after you buy. BC Hydro pays it as a credit on your bill within one or two billing periods. Air fryers are the exception: they only get the rebate at the till. Keep your receipt either way, and read BC Hydro's terms for the application deadline before you shop.
The community top-up, place by place

BC Hydro pays extra in parts of the province where demand for power is growing fastest. Only select postal codes qualify, not whole cities, so use the postal code checker on BC Hydro's community page. Here is how the places it names line up with the cities we cover:

CityWhat BC Hydro lists
AbbotsfordAbbotsford is listed, and so is Mount Lehman
SurreyCampbell Heights only
Maple RidgeMaple Ridge is listed
CoquitlamBurke Mountain, listed with Port Coquitlam
Vancouverselect neighbourhoods west of Cambie
Victoriaselect neighbourhoods
VernonVernon is listed, plus select communities between Kelowna and Vernon

BC Hydro also names the Northeast Fraser Valley from Mission to Agassiz, Sun Peaks, West Kelowna and White Rock. It names no area in Burnaby, Richmond, Langley, Nanaimo, Kamloops, Prince George, Fort St. John or Squamish. In those cities you get the regular rebate only. BC Hydro's community page lists bigger heat pump and EV charger top-ups for the same postal codes.
Kelowna and Penticton follow FortisBC rules

BC Hydro's appliance deals need a BC Hydro account, so they do not help most Kelowna homes, where FortisBC supplies the power, or Penticton homes, which buy power from the City of Penticton. FortisBC runs its own appliance rebates and names City of Penticton customers as eligible.

FortisBC pays $100 for a washer with an IMEF of 2.92 or more and an IWF of 3.2 or less. Dryers earn $100, $150 or $250 depending on their efficiency score (CEF). Fridges earn $50 or $100. You can claim up to two per appliance type per household, and you must apply within 60 days of buying or delivery. FortisBC customers get a bill credit. Penticton customers get a cheque. FortisBC says it can take up to 90 days.
Check the model before you pay

An ENERGY STAR sticker is not enough. Both utilities pay only for models on their own lists, and those lists change each season. Look up the exact model number on the list, then check that the receipt shows it. If a store near you is out of stock, BC Hydro suggests checking other nearby participating stores.
Should you replace a fridge that still works?

A $50 or $75 rebate rarely pays for replacing an appliance that runs fine. These rebates help most when an old washer or fridge is already failing and you have to buy a new one anyway. If your home has a lot of electric heat, a heat pump or insulation saves far more, and those rebates are much larger. See our BC heat pump page and your city's insulation page.

Neither BC Hydro's fall list nor FortisBC's rebate list includes an induction cooktop, a range, a dishwasher or a freezer on October 11, 2026. BC Hydro also offers free products and advice to lower-income customers through its income-qualified programs, which is worth checking before you buy.
claim_steps: Check your power bill: BC Hydro, FortisBC or City of Penticton.
BC Hydro: enter your postal code on BC Hydro's community page to see if you get the top-up.
Find the exact model on the right utility's eligible list.
Buy at a participating store to save at the till, or anywhere and apply online after.
If you qualify for the top-up, apply online after you buy, even if you already got money off at the till.
FortisBC or Penticton: apply online within 60 days with your account number and an itemized receipt.

faq: Is there a BC Hydro air fryer rebate?
Yes. BC Hydro takes $25 off select air fryers from October 2, 2026 to March 5, 2027. The air fryer must be on BC Hydro's list and cost $50 or more.
Does a combo air fryer qualify?
No. Only single basket and dual basket air fryers count. Models that also grill, toast, work as a toaster oven or multi-cook are not eligible.
Can I apply for the air fryer rebate after I buy?
No. Air fryers only get the $25 at the till. BC Hydro does not give a post-purchase rebate for them.
Where can I buy an air fryer with the BC Hydro rebate?
In store: Best Buy, Canadian Tire, Costco, London Drugs, RONA, The Brick and Visions Electronics. Online: Best Buy, The Brick and Visions Electronics. The store must be in BC Hydro's service area.
How much is the BC Hydro washer rebate?
$50 off an ENERGY STAR clothes washer on BC Hydro's eligible list, until January 8, 2027. You can claim up to two units of each listed model per purchase.
How much is the BC Hydro fridge rebate?
$75 off an ENERGY STAR refrigerator on BC Hydro's list, until January 8, 2027. The fridge must be at least 15% more efficient than the federal standard.
How much is the BC Hydro dryer rebate?
Up to $150 off an ENERGY STAR clothes dryer on BC Hydro's list, until January 8, 2027. The amount depends on the model.
Is there a rebate for a washer-dryer combo?
Yes. BC Hydro pays $100 on ENERGY STAR combination washer-dryers on its list, until January 8, 2027. This is one machine that does both jobs.
What is a laundry centre, and does it get a rebate?
A laundry centre is a washer and dryer stacked in one unit. BC Hydro pays $200 on laundry centres on its eligible list, until January 8, 2027.
Is there a BC Hydro dishwasher or freezer rebate?
Not on BC Hydro's list as of October 28, 2026. Its appliance deals cover washers, dryers, fridges, washer-dryer combos and laundry centres, plus air fryers.
Can I get the instant rebate and the community top-up on the same appliance?
Yes, if your postal code qualifies. The till rebate comes off when you pay. BC Hydro pays the community top-up only through an online application after you buy.
Does a heat pump dryer qualify?
Only if that exact model is on BC Hydro's eligible dryer list, or for FortisBC customers, on FortisBC's list. Dryers with higher efficiency scores earn more from FortisBC, up to $250.
I live in Kelowna. Why can't I use BC Hydro's deal?
Most of Kelowna gets its power from FortisBC, and BC Hydro's rebates need a BC Hydro account. FortisBC's own rebates pay $100 for a washer, up to $250 for a dryer and up to $100 for a fridge.
How many appliances can I claim?
BC Hydro allows up to two units of each listed model per purchase. FortisBC allows up to two rebates per appliance type per household.
Is there a rebate for an induction stove?
Not from BC Hydro or FortisBC as of October 11, 2026. Neither utility's appliance list includes cooktops or ranges.
